Options: 
A. $75.83, $118.33
B. $90.83, $133.33
C. $80.83, $123.33
D. $55.83, $98.33
E. $50.83, $93.33
F. $70.83, $113.33
G. $45.83, $88.33
H. $85.83, $128.33
I. $60.83, $103.33
J. $65.83, $108.33

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
